assertions.description: Removing a same-origin <iframe> with iframe.remove() destroys its child navigable without firing pagehide inside it (HTML 'destroy a child navigable' fires no events). Legacy Chrome fires pagehide synchronously inside remove(), so this fails without OmitSubframeDetachmentEventsOnRemoval.
assertions.test: (async () => { const mk = (doc) => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); f.tabIndex = -1; f.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;border:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none'; f.srcdoc = doc; const loaded = new Promise((r) => f.addEventListener('load', r, { once: true })); document.body.append(f); return loaded.then(() => f); }; const S = '<' + 'script>', E = '<' + '/script>'; const log = []; globalThis.__sfcPagehide = log; const f = await mk(S + 'addEventListener("pagehide", function(){ parent.__sfcPagehide.push(1); })' + E); f.remove(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); delete globalThis.__sfcPagehide; return log.length === 0; })()

assertions.description: A subframe cannot re-enter the parent's removal: with a pagehide handler that re-appends its own frameElement elsewhere, iframe.remove() still returns without throwing and leaves the iframe disconnected (legacy Chrome throws NotFoundError and leaves a connected iframe with no browsing context).
assertions.test: (async () => { const mk = (doc) => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); f.tabIndex = -1; f.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;border:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none'; f.srcdoc = doc; const loaded = new Promise((r) => f.addEventListener('load', r, { once: true })); document.body.append(f); return loaded.then(() => f); }; const S = '<' + 'script>', E = '<' + '/script>'; const other = document.createElement('div'); other.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); other.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;opacity:0'; document.body.append(other); globalThis.__sfcOther = other; const f = await mk(S + 'addEventListener("pagehide", function(){ parent.__sfcOther.append(frameElement); })' + E); let threw = false; try { f.remove(); } catch (e) { threw = true; } const ok = !threw && !f.isConnected; other.remove(); delete globalThis.__sfcOther; return ok; })()

assertions.description: HTML Standard contract for a frame that cannot script its ancestors: removing a sandbox="allow-scripts" (opaque-origin) iframe fires no pagehide in it (reported over a transferred MessagePort, 400 ms window). Note: ChromeStatus scopes Chrome's change to scriptable subframes, so a Chrome build that keeps firing here still meets the Chrome proposal while not meeting the spec.
assertions.test: (async () => { const mk = (doc) => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); f.tabIndex = -1; f.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;border:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none'; f.srcdoc = doc; const loaded = new Promise((r) => f.addEventListener('load', r, { once: true })); document.body.append(f); return loaded.then(() => f); }; const S = '<' + 'script>', E = '<' + '/script>'; const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-scripts'); f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); f.tabIndex = -1; f.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;border:0;opacity:0'; f.srcdoc = S + 'var p; addEventListener("message", function(e){ p = e.ports[0]; p.postMessage("ready"); }); addEventListener("pagehide", function(){ if (p) p.postMessage("pagehide"); })' + E; const loaded = new Promise((r) => f.addEventListener('load', r, { once: true })); document.body.append(f); await loaded; const mc = new MessageChannel(); const got = []; const ready = new Promise((r) => { mc.port1.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data === 'ready') r(true); else got.push(e.data); }; setTimeout(() => r(false), 1500); }); f.contentWindow.postMessage('port', '*', [mc.port2]); if (!(await ready)) return false; f.remove(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); mc.port1.close(); return got.length === 0; })()

assertions.description: Control (must hold in both modes): once removed, a subframe's document is destroyed and its timers stop — a 20 ms setInterval heartbeat delivers nothing after remove(), so cleanup cannot be deferred to a later task inside the frame.
assertions.test: (async () => { const mk = (doc) => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); f.tabIndex = -1; f.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;border:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none'; f.srcdoc = doc; const loaded = new Promise((r) => f.addEventListener('load', r, { once: true })); document.body.append(f); return loaded.then(() => f); }; const S = '<' + 'script>', E = '<' + '/script>'; const st = { removed: false, after: 0, before: 0 }; globalThis.__sfcBeat = () => { if (st.removed) st.after++; else st.before++; }; const f = await mk(S + 'setInterval(function(){ parent.__sfcBeat(); }, 20)' + E); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 120)); f.remove(); st.removed = true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); delete globalThis.__sfcBeat; return st.before > 0 && st.after === 0; })()

assertions.description: In an A1 → B (cross-site, out-of-process) → A2 (same-site as A1) frame sandwich, removing B from A1 must not synchronously run A2's pagehide/unload inside A1's removal (the case that made the 'can access any ancestor' gate necessary).
assertions.test: Needs two distinct sites served side by side (e.g. localhost and 127.0.0.1); this deployment has a single origin. Covered by Blink web test fast/frames/subframe-detachment-events-on-removal.html per ChromeStatus.
